sentences.en: She plays the violin as her music instrument.
sentences.zh: 她把小提琴当作自己的乐器来演奏。

sentences.en: Among his many music instruments, he prefers the guitar.
sentences.zh: 在他的许多乐器中，他更喜欢吉他。

sentences.en: Learning to play a new music instrument can be challenging but rewarding.
sentences.zh: 学习演奏新的乐器可能会有挑战但也很值得。
